items.claim: The span's mandated ketiv/qere disclosure is missing and four byte-true devices inside the span go unengaged, including a second divine speech-frame that licenses an undisclosed internal cut and the row's own closing clause, which recurs verbatim two units later.
items.evidence: All three pointed runs re-collate at byte tier against their cited verses, and the layout statement is accurate and correctly tiered (no poetry-line openings across the span). (3) oshb:Isa.37.34 closes נְאֻם יְהוָֽה (tier: byte) — the ONLY postpositive oracle signature in the whole narrative zone (sweep: 1 verse in MT 36:1-39:8 of 23 book-wide), standing one verse before the row's own close and unengaged. (4) oshb:Isa.37.23 carries אֶל קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל (tier: byte), the only Holy-One-of-Israel title site in the narrative zone (sweep: 1 of 25 title verses book-wide); oshb:Isa.37.24 carries בְּיַ֣ד עֲבָדֶיךָ֮ חֵרַ֣פְתָּ אֲדֹנָי֒ (tier: byte), a bare-adonai token in the exact zone where that census is role-split; and the remnant forms stand at oshb:Isa.37.31 and oshb:Isa.37.32 — none engaged. (5) The row quotes oshb:Isa.37.35 in full but does not note that its opening clause וְגַנּוֹתִ֛י עַל הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֖את recurs at oshb:Isa.38.6 as וְגַנּוֹתִ֖י עַל הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּֽאת — a two-site clause book-wide (sweep: 2 verses, finals-normalized skeleton tier), reactivated inside the healing narrative two units on. That is a byte-true device bracketing the row's own rear seam, owed disclosure under cross-seam cohesion. The bound itself is defensible; the evidence set is not complete.

items.claim: The rival is dismissed by denying an addressee shift that the cited verse's own bytes name explicitly, and the second divine frame inside the span is never quoted or attributed.
items.evidence: Both pointed runs re-collate at byte tier, all three parashah disclosures verify as SAMEKH at oshb:Isa.37.38, oshb:Isa.38.3 and oshb:Isa.38.8, and no ketiv/qere note falls in the span. items.claim: The three-site Yah digit is attached to a swept object the sweep does not return, and the rear edge is asserted in English while two divine-title sites inside the span and a seam-straddling adjacency go unengaged.
items.evidence: All three pointed runs re-collate at byte tier; the header-class distinction is byte-supported (מִכְתָּ֖ב לְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ is not a chazah/ben-Amots frame); no parashah mark and no ketiv/qere note falls inside oshb:Isa.38.9-Isa.38.20, and the preceding SAMEKH at oshb:Isa.38.8 is correctly typed and disclosed. Defects: (1) the row calls oshb:Isa.38.11's doubled יָ֔הּ יָ֖הּ 'one of only three standalone-Yah sites in the book'. The 3-site digit belongs to the standalone-OR-PREFIXED short-form object. A finals-normalized exact-token sweep of the standalone short form returns TWO verses — oshb:Isa.12.2 יָ֣הּ יְהוָ֔ה and oshb:Isa.38.11 יָ֔הּ יָ֖הּ — because the third site, oshb:Isa.26.4, carries the prefixed form בְּיָ֣הּ יְהוָ֔ה (all tier: byte). Its byte warrant — the third-person wayyiqtol onset וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְשַׁעְיָ֔הוּ at oshb:Isa.38.21 against the psalm's first person — is never quoted, and a byte-true adjacency straddles that seam undisclosed: עַל בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה at oshb:Isa.38.20 and the same two tokens inside oshb:Isa.38.22 (sweep: 6 verses book-wide, finals-normalized skeleton tier).
